title: Indian Wrestler Acquitted in Sexual Harassment Case
summary: Brij Bhushan Singh, a wrestler and former president of the Wrestling Federation of India, was acquitted in a sexual harassment case. The Delhi court delivered its verdict on [date]. Singh was accused by two women wrestlers, who alleged that he had made unwanted advances towards them during their association with the federation. The acquittal has been met with mixed reactions from various stakeholders, including wrestlers and opposition parties.
summary_points: Brij Bhushan Singh acquitted in a sexual harassment case
Two women wrestlers accused him of making unwanted advances
Acquittal delivered by a Delhi court on [date]
Mixed reactions from wrestlers and opposition parties
